description: Change a network from craftos_network_create while it runs: move a computer, right-click a wired modem to switch its computer on or off the network, or unload/load a computer's chunk. The changes given are applied in that order; the other computers keep running. Use it to test how programs cope with a computer moving away, dropping off the cable or reloading.

loaded.description: false unloads the computer's chunk (it stops; on 2.2.36 linked computers get peripheral_detach for its peripherals), true loads it again (it boots afresh).

modem.description: Wired modem's peripheral name, used with on.

on.description: With modem: true connects the computer to the cable network, false disconnects it.

position.description: New block position; only the fields given change.

name: craftos_network_update
